our_title: gscat synopsis in dgscat(1) and the PT-Scotch manual omits the mandatory nparts parameter
ran: Pristine 7.0.18 32-bit: command line written after dgscat.1.txt:9 `gscat [options] [igfile] [ogfile]`: `gscat src/check/data/m4x4.grf out.grf` -> `gscat: ERROR: main: invalid number of parts '.../m4x4.grf'`; `gscat -h` -> `gscat <nparts> <input source file> <output target file pattern> <options>`. Same on the patched tree (doc-only fix).
evidence: dgscat.1.txt:9 `  gscat [options] [igfile] [ogfile]`; p_p.tex:479 `{\tt dgscat} [{\it input\_graph\_file} [{\it output\_graph\_file}]] {\it options}` (no gscat line); gscat.c:72 `"gscat <nparts> <input source file> <output target file pattern> <options>",`; gscat.c:105-107 `if (C_paraNum < 1) { if ((p[C_paraNum ++] = atoi (argv[i])) < 1) errorPrint ("main: invalid number of parts '%s'", argv[i]);`

fix_options.label: a. Document nparts in the man page source, the generated page and p_p.tex (shipped)
fix_options.summary: Synopsis `gscat [options] nparts [igfile] [ogfile]`, one sentence in the description, -Inparts in man/man1/Makefile; p_p.tex gets a gscat synopsis line in the dgmap/dgpart style ({\it number\_\lbt of\_\lbt parts}) and the same sentence.
fix_options.tested: git am on fresh v7.0.18; the .1 page was edited by hand to what txt2man produces for the same source (txt2man not installed here)
fix_options.maintainer_fit: same kind of doc fix as his cf82942a for the usage line; follows the dgpart synopsis in p_p.tex

upstream_fix_review.details: Not a defect of cf82942a, which is correct for BLD-23: it fixed the gscat usage line but its documentation twin dgscat.1.txt:9 / p_p.tex:479 still lacks the <nparts> parameter that the same usage line shows first.
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Our 7.0.17 series missed it too (usage_vs_man.py compares options only, not positional parameters).
